h1: Take Years Off Your Face With Fillers

blocks.html: Mirror mirror on the wall, who has the smallest crow’s feet of them all? Do you want that to be you?  Are you starting to see wrinkles and fine lines creep in as you age? Another thing you might notice is that your eyes or cheeks are starting to appear hollow. Unfortunately, these can be common signs of aging, but there are ways to correct these issues.

Facial fillers, or dermal fillers, are FDA approved injectable gels that can help plump up your face to allow for a more youthful look while only being a minimally invasive method. That means you can achieve great results in less than 30 minutes depending on the filler used without subjecting yourself to surgery. Many of the facial fillers can last six months or longer.

blocks.text: Are Dermal Fillers Similar to Botox®?

blocks.html: Dermal fillers are used to correct lines, wrinkles, and creases by plumping the skin within. Botox® only prevents muscles from moving which cause the creases and fine lines.

blocks.text: There are Many Advantages to Using Facial Fillers Over Other Treatments

blocks.html: One of the main advantages of using facial fillers at Victory MedSpa in Austin, TX is that they offer noticeable improvement in skin issues such as fine lines, wrinkles, and creases. This is an advantage as many do not want to undergo surgical procedures to improve these issues. Although surgical procedures can offer dramatic results, then can often result in complications such as infection, slower healing, and issues with the incision sites. Side effects from facial dermal fillers are minor.  Some may notice temporary redness, swelling, or bruising at the treatment sites. These all typically fade away within a few hours to a couple of days without any intervention.

blocks.text: How Long Will Facial Filler Results Last?

blocks.html: Many facial fillers use a variety of substances that are in the form of a gel. One of the more common substances used by facial fillers is hyaluronic acid which is favored because it helps attract water molecules within your skin and binds with them. Hyaluronic acid is something your body makes in abundance when you are young, but as you age, this decreases significantly. Fillers can help slow down the appearance of aging by replacing the areas that have lost volume with these gel-like FDA approved substances. Many fillers can last for 6 months to a year or more.
